text_block_list.text:
I was asked to help find something, so 
I've been helping out, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's gone... It's not here either...! My 
precious notebook with the winning 
formula!"
choice_data_list: Where do you usually keep it?
Where do you usually keep it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Normally?! Normally it's in my pocket—...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... so it was here. ...Seems fatigue 
is finally clouding my mind.

This uncharacteristic mistake seems to 
stem from recent fatigue. Perhaps I should 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
